prose: Google Cloud announced Gemini for healthcare, a purpose-built industry layer extending the Gemini agent introduced at Gemini at Work. It targets fragmented healthcare data: records, coverage policies and clinical evidence trapped in disconnected systems, with clinicians spending nearly 28 hours a week reconciling information. The pitch is a governed orchestration layer across existing systems with human oversight.
highlights: Gemini for healthcare: industry-specific agent layer
Aims at fragmented records, claims and evidence
Claims clinicians spend about 28 hours a week on reconciliation
